message.content:
**ServiceNow, Inc. (CIK 1373715) — operating expense profile, FY2022–FY2024 (fiscal years ended Dec 31; latest annual report: 10-K for FY2024, accession 0001373715-25-000010)**

**Total operating expenses (disclosed, USD millions):** FY2022 $5,317 → FY2023 $6,288 → FY2024 $7,333. Growth: +18.3% in FY2023 and +16.6% in FY2024 (calculated). Revenue grew faster in FY2024 (+22.4%, $8,971M → $10,984M), so total operating expenses fell from 73.4% of revenue (FY2022) to 70.1% (FY2023) to 66.8% (FY2024) — a clear operating-leverage improvement (ratios calculated from disclosed revenue and OperatingExpenses facts).

**Composition (disclosed, USD millions):**
| Line | FY2022 | FY2023 | FY2024 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cost of revenue | 1,573 | 1,921 | 2,287 |
| R&D | 1,768 | 2,124 | 2,543 |
| Sales & marketing | 2,814 | 3,301 | 3,854 |
| G&A | 735 | 863 | 936 |
| Operating income | 355 | 762 | 1,364 |

Operating income more than tripled over the two years, consistent with expense growth trailing revenue growth.

**What drove the FY2024 change (per the FY2024 10-K MD&A):**
- Sales & marketing +$553M: higher headcount/personnel costs (+$330M), amortization of deferred commissions (+$90M) on more new/expansion/renewal contracts, and program/branding/event costs (+$95M) (chunk 1373715/now-20241231:187453).
- R&D +$419M: headcount-driven personnel costs (+$350M), outside services (+$48M), data-center capacity software/maintenance (+$27M), partly offset by lower program spend (−$12M) (chunk :188790).
- G&A +$73M: personnel costs ex-SBC (+$37M) and other corporate/outside services (+$67M), partly offset by $36M lower stock-based compensation as performance-award service periods were met (chunk :190139).
- Cost of subscription revenue +$336M, mainly personnel (+$230M) and data-center capacity costs (+$85M) (chunk :184691).

**Limitations:** The database contains only the FY2024 annual report locally, so FY2022–FY2023 narrative drivers are not available here; those years are shown from structured facts only. The company also states a forward-looking expectation that FY2025 sales & marketing expense will rise in absolute dollars but decline slightly as a percentage of revenue (chunk :188276) — that is a plan/outlook, not a reported result. All figures are as originally disclosed (repeated comparative disclosures in later filings were not summed; the latest FY2024 10-K values were used).
